evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce MLOps-Bench, a repository-grounded benchmark for production ML engineering.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Each task is grounded in repository evidence and includes a natural-language requirement, oracle patch, plausible buggy baseline, fail-to-pass tests, pass-to-pass tests, and provenance metadata.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Each task is grounded in repository evidence and includes a natural-language requirement, oracle patch, plausible buggy baseline, fail-to-pass tests, pass-to-pass tests, and provenance metadata.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: The benchmark contains 212 validated tasks from 31 public ML repositories, with 636 fail-to-pass tests and 856 pass-to-pass tests.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: MLOps-Bench shifts agent evaluation beyond model building and issue fixing toward repository-native MLOps work where correctness depends on lifecycle reasoning, behavioral robustness, and preservation of existing system behavior.
